WoW: Forever

Holy Priest

The reactive Light healer, and the published line on it is beginner-friendliness: "great all-rounders… very beginner-friendly." The published advice for soloing is to use Shadow talents until you can heal in groups.

WoW: Forever · Healer · Updated October 5, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70124 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Holy build has been tested. Talent rows unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40. The one-point milestone talents are gated on points spent, not on level: 11, 21 and 31 points as in Classic, now joined by a new 16-point milestone. No source has posted a level 30 build either — the cap only reached 30 on October 1 and none of the three has published one since — so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended. Blizzard's own September 30, 2026 Class Deep Dive post is folded in below and takes priority over the three guide sites; its own caveat applies: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

What Holy is for

Raw healing throughput. Binding HealBinding HealTalentCast1.5 sec castCost155 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target and the caster for 247. Low threat. at 25 is a 1.5-second cast on no cooldown that heals your target and you, and Blizzard says it is tuned to be as good as Flash HealFlash HealLevel 20 · Spell · HolyCast1.5 sec castCost125 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target for 194. even when you need no healing yourself; Holy NovaHoly NovaLevel 20 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost185 Mana at exactly 20 heals the party while it deals damage, and generates no threat; and Litany of LightLitany of LightTalentCastInstantWhen you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 20% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell. refunds part of a heal's Mana cost every time you alternate heals rather than spam one. The published line on the spec is beginner-friendliness: "great all-rounders… very beginner-friendly."

Ratings: Overall 3.5, Levelling 2.0, Dungeon 4.0, Utility 4.0, Mobility 1.0. The levelling number measures solo kill speed and nothing else. The published heading is "Zero AoE and Lackluster Damage": "While Holy Priests are great at their role of healing, they lack tools to solo level effectively. It's typically recommended to play with a group if you plan to level as Holy, otherwise it is a better idea to primarily use Shadow talents until you're able to get into group content."

If you are soloing, level Shadow and respec. That is the published recommendation, quoted above. Dual Specialization becomes available at level 40, so above that you keep both; below it, respeccing is a trainer visit. In the beta that visit costs 1 silver if you have not changed talents recently, much more for a second reset, and it falls back to 1 silver once an hour has passed — Blizzard calls the price "temporary for the Beta only."

If you are levelling in groups, the published dungeon rating is 4.0 out of 5, against 2.0 for levelling. The levelling number is about killing things by yourself; that Holy is not slower at reaching 60 is our own reading, not a published rating.

Stat priority

Healing Power, then MP5, Spirit, Intellect, critical strike.

Critical strike is explicitly last: "Critical Strike is likely the lowest of our stat priorities as a Holy Priest… crits you may get will often translate into accidental overhealing." It is worth slightly more than that line suggests now that InspirationInspirationTalentCastInstant triggers off every non-periodic critical heal, not just the old proc list — our own reading, and no source has revised its stat order for it.

Do not itemise Hit for healing gear. Holy PrecisionHoly PrecisionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%. (Discipline tree, one early point) grants up to 18% Holy spell hit, and Blizzard states the point outright: the talent exists "to remove the need for hit chance on healing Priests, who are not expected to wear gear that increased hit chance." That applies to Holy's own heals exactly as much as Discipline's.

The one-third figure belongs to a talent, not to gear. It is Spiritual GuidanceSpiritual GuidanceTalentCastInstantIncreases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit. that gives a bonus to spell damage "approximately one third as much as the bonus to spell healing" — see What Forever changed below. Nothing in Blizzard's post makes healing bonus on gear grant spell damage.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
